title: Safety and Tolerability of AGN-199201 in Patients With Erythema Associated With Rosacea
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and tolerability of AGN-199201 for the treatment of erythema associated with rosacea.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* facial erythema associated with rosacea on both sides of the face

Exclusion Criteria:

* Laser light-source or other energy based therapy in the last 6 months
* Excessive hair around the treatment area
